description:
Seo-In's family fled to America after learning that their lives were threatened by someone close by. Seven years later, Seo-In and his family are once again threatened in Korea. Seo-In decides to take everything from them and gather strength for revenge. In order to take revenge, she visits 'Jaden Taylor' of Taylor Corporation. He is a man who is the epitome of arrogance. Seo-In's will is actually burning as she sees Jaden acting selfishly as if he doesn't know Seo-In's desperation. Was that why? The more Seo-in struggles to get what he wants from Jaden Taylor, the more the presence of Jaden Taylor in Seo-In's heart begins to grow... 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
